AUTHOR: Jahanbakht
TITLE: Semi-supervised and weakly-supervised deep neural networks and dataset for fish detection in turbid underwater videos
REGION: Port of Mackay, Queensland, Australia (two geolocations)
SPECIES: Fish presence vs absence per frame (no species)
DATA: Own FishInTurbidWater dataset: 1800 min of video from a 15-camera rope array dropped at two sites around Port of Mackay; weakly labelled fish/no-fish frames; 30% carefully relabelled for validation
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'the turbidity level during this period was variable between 1 and 105 NTU' (Fig. 3 NTU distribution from port monitoring program)
D2: 30% of dataset carefully labelled as validation/test; 20% of weakly labelled training data used for fine-tuning contrastive model
D_EV: no statement found on split unit (Sec. 3 only: '30% of the whole FishInTurbidWater was carefully labeled manually to make a solid validation dataset')
R_EV: Sec. 3: results 'obtained using the carefully labeled FishInTurbidWater validation dataset' (single dataset; literature comparison only)
C_EV: no statement found (no decision threshold reported; Sec. 3 only notes AUC-ROC 'is a performance measurement of a classifier against various probability thresholds')
E_EV: Table 1: only 'Accuracy', 'Precision', 'F1-score', 'AUC-ROC' for frame-level fish presence; no ecological variable
ARCH: Semi-supervised SimCLR-style contrastive ResNet-50 + small decoder; weakly-supervised EfficientNet-B7 and ViT (ImageNet transfer) combined by XGBoost ensemble
METR: Accuracy, precision, F1, AUC-ROC, confusion matrix (TPR/TNR/FNR/FPR), turnaround time
NOTE: Binary fish/no-fish classification of whole (uncropped) video frames, treated as presence detection so C rules applied (not NA); no threshold reported -> C_ALL=NR. NTU values come from a port water-quality monitoring program at the same geolocation (1-105 NTU distribution), not linked to individual clips and no performance stratification -> V_ALL=P. Split unit for the 30% validation set (frames vs videos/drops) not described -> D1=NR (possible frame-level leakage unassessed). PLAT: drop camera array on rope from boat (coded fixed camera; could be NR). ENV: port coastal waters, no matching category -> NR. XGBoost ensemble is a classifier combiner, not uncertainty estimation (C3=없음).
